# Lengua de vaca / Hedgehog mushroom

*Hydnum repandum*

Ectomycorrhizal with broadleaves and conifers. Long season; fruit bodies persist into winter.

**Habitats:** beech, mixed, oak, pine

## Season

Ramps up from 08-01, peak 09-15 to 12-15, ends 02-28. Evidence grade **C**.

GBIF near Tierra Estella, n=147: Jan 13, Feb 12, Mar 2, Jun 7, Jul 2, Aug 6, Sep 17, Oct 40, Nov 34, Dec 13.

### Rationale

- **rain:** Autumn rain a week or more before. Values are ours. (field_guides)
- **water_balance:** Water balance as a better moisture signal than rain alone. Values are ours. (agreda2015)
- **temperature:** Cool-tolerant; local records continue into winter. The range is ours. (field_guides, gbif_tierra_estella)
- **frost:** Frost-tolerant compared with most autumn species. Counts are ours. (field_guides)
